result.brief: 将人手视频转化为机器人可用的操作数据，用于策略协同训练，属于机器人数据生成与策略学习，而非世界模型或表征学习贡献。
result.reason: Main contribution is robotizing human videos for robot policy co-training (contact reconstruction, compositing), not a world-model or representation contribution; no video/world model or representation learning innovation.
